---

This page makes the original Sweave vignette available from the pkgdown
Articles index. The source vignette remains `vignettes/lmvnorm_src.Rnw`; the
PDF is the installed vignette returned by:

```r
vignette("lmvnorm_src", package = "mvtnorm")
```

The local in-browser PDF preview can render as a blank or black pane on some
systems, so the PDF is linked rather than embedded here.

[Open the original PDF vignette](lmvnorm_src.pdf)
